items.notes: This code pauses the program. Press Cycle Start to resume. The modal state does not reset.
Halts only if the optional-stop button is enabled on the control.
Ends the program without rewinding to the start.
The rotation direction follows the machine manual's viewing convention. Pair this code with an S word and either G96 or G97.
Use this code for left-hand threads or reverse rotation when required by the verified setup.
This code stops spindle rotation. Issue it before retractions or changes when the procedure requires it.
This code turns on flood coolant. Some controls use M08 and M09 or separate codes for through-spindle coolant and mist.
This code turns off the coolant and is often issued at the end of a program.
This standard end-of-program code ends the program and returns the cursor to the beginning.
